description: Our goal is to develop a solution that will support life on the surface of Mars and enable humanity to expand its reach much further.
summary: In this project, we sought an answer to the question, "How can we survive on the surface of Mars?" and prepared this presentation. We researched not only the Martian surface itself but also the spacecraft required for the return journey. We also included information in our presentation regarding the equipment necessary for survival on Mars and how it should be used.
